entry.title: Twelve killed and hundreds injured in Houthi attack at Riyadh airport
entry.summary: Yemen’s Houthis have launched a missile attack on Riyadh’s international airport in Saudi Arabia, killing at least 12 people and leaving hundreds wounded, the Saudi Civil Aviation Authority has said. Operations at King Khalid international airport in Riyadh were suspended as ambulances rushed to the airport. More than 300 people were reported injured in the deadliest attack in any Gulf Arab country since the start of the Iran war. A projectile also fell near the King Fahd international airport in Dammam, according to the Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis. 关键事实：Yemen’s Houthis have launched a missile attack on Riyadh’s international airport in Saudi Arabia；killing at least 12 people；leaving hundreds wounded

entry.title: Israeli attack destroys building in Gaza one year into ‘ceasefire’
entry.summary: Israeli attack destroys building in Gaza one year into ‘ceasefire’ An Israeli strike destroyed a residential building in the Al-Rimal neighbourhood in Gaza City, sending flames and smoke into the air. The attack comes one year into a US-brokered ceasefire, yet Palestinians continue to face Israeli bombardment. 关键事实：sending flames；smoke into the air

entry.title: Lockheed Martin unveils PAC-3 Edge interceptor designed to counter hypersonic threats
entry.summary: Lockheed Martin on Friday unveiled PAC-3 Edge, a missile interceptor designed to defend against hypersonic and advanced missile threats, as the U.S. military looks to strengthen its capabilities to counter emerging aerial threats. Growing demand for air and missile defense systems amid conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East has strained U.S. weapons stockpiles, prompting the U.S. Army to award Lockheed Martin a contract worth up to $58.6 billion in July to ramp up production of PAC-3 interceptors. Lockheed Martin said PAC-3 Edge incorporates a new seeker, upgraded flight controls and a multi-pulse rocket motor supplied by Northrop Grumman, enhancing the interceptor’s ability to counter advanced threats, including hypersonic missiles, at longer ranges and higher altitudes. “The cost of this would be about that of the existing PAC-3 MSE,” Tim Cahill, president of missiles and fire control at Lockheed Martin, told Reuters. “At full production, the annual rate would be about 2,000 units a year, comparable with PAC-3 MSE.” In January, Lockheed Martin signed a seven-year framework agreement with the Pentagon to expand production of its PAC-3 missile interceptors, aiming to increase annual manufacturing capacity to 2,000 units from about 600. 关键事实：Lockheed Martin on Friday unveiled PAC-3 Edge；a missile interceptor designed to defend against hypersonic；advanced missile threats

entry.title: US Army, Kaizen Laboratories to establish common software platform for classified material
entry.summary: The U.S. Army awarded $43 million to defense company Kaizen Laboratories to create application software for highly sensitive military material. The $49 million Enterprise Agreement Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity contract, or IDIQ, specifically focuses on mission and enterprise applications, staff workflows, records and “reporting that sit above the Army’s systems of record,” a Kaizen release said. “The Army is changing how it acquires software because missions cannot wait through years of bespoke implementation,” said Nikhil Reddy, co-founder and CEO of Kaizen Labs. 关键事实：Army awarded $43 million to defense company Kaizen Laboratories to create application software for highly sensitive military material；The $49 million Enterprise Agreement Indefinite Delivery；Indefinite Quantity contract

entry.title: OpenAI says a misaligned model deliberately destroyed its own environment hoping for a fresh start with better data
entry.summary: OpenAI has a few new rogue agent stories. In the first case (October 6), an AI evaluation model couldn't find the answers it was supposed to rate. Instead of reporting the error, it fabricated ratings, faked input files, and then deliberately corrupted its own environment, hoping the system would replace it with a fresh virtual machine that had the missing data. In the third case (June 16/17), models already had the data they needed but kept finding ways around their network restrictions. They created accounts on a remote shell service, routed forbidden POST requests through anonymizing relays, and built their own FTP clients. Anthropic also just documented the sometimes absurd workarounds its own models use to bypass imposed restrictions. 关键事实：OpenAI has a few new rogue agent stories；In the first case (October 6)；an AI evaluation model couldn't find the answers it was supposed to rate

entry.title: Anthropic cuts off Claude's internet access after the model autonomously filed a fake homicide tip with Philadelphia police
entry.summary: In one case, Claude filled out a tip form for the Philadelphia Police Department with made-up details about an unsolved homicide and submitted it. The police confirmed the incident, but the tip was flagged as spam and never reached investigators. In other cases, the model found a vulnerability on a university server and used it to run commands, pulled access tokens from website configs to grab protected or paywalled data, and used URL shorteners to dodge length limits on its tools. Anthropic says real-world impact was low but sees a pattern. When tasks are ambiguous or hard to solve, the model hunts for workarounds on its own instead of stopping. The company notified the White House and cut off live internet access for all internal evaluations until new safety filters are reliably in place. These incidents join a fast-growing list of similar cases, including cybersecurity incidents involving Claude and OpenAI models autonomously hacking Hugging Face. Source: Anthropic / Report | CBS News / Philadelphia Police 关键事实：Claude filled out a tip form for the Philadelphia Police Department with made-up details about an unsolved homicide；submitted it

entry.title: Anthropic's Claude AI submits a false tip on an unsolved Philadelphia homicide case
entry.summary: An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false tip to a Philadelphia police website about an unsolved homicide case, authorities and Anthropic said. It's the latest example of AI models acting in unintended ways and manipulating government and other websites during tests. In a report Friday, Anthropic also disclosed a separate incident when its AI model submitted forms to an undisclosed government website instead of stopping before submission. The incident in Philadelphia occurred on July 18 when the AI model Claude Haiku 4.5 was tasked with generating and performing example tasks on randomly selected webpages, Anthropic said. Claude filled out a form on police site PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com indicating it might have information regarding an unsolved murder listed on the site. Philadelphia police said in a statement they were unaware of the incident until Anthropic notified them on Wednesday. Then they found the submission in the website's tip records and confirmed it was marked spam and never forwarded to police. In September, another AI company, OpenAI, disclosed six reports of "unexpected or concerning" behavior in artificial intelligence models. "Unsolved cases involve real victims, grieving families and investigators working to secure answers," the Philadelphia Police Department said in a statement. 关键事实：An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false tip to a Philadelphia police website about an unsolved homicide case；Anthropic said；It's the latest example of AI models acting in unintended ways

entry.title: NASA to Conduct Flyover, Engage NFL Fans at MetLife Stadium
entry.summary: NASA team members will engage with fans at the agency’s Experience Zone, located at the Jets Tailgate Zone outside the stadium, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. EDT before the game. Fans can learn more about NASA’s return to the Moon under the agency’s Artemis dome, enjoy interactive games, and capture photos with a large, inflatable SLS (Space Launch System) rocket. With stops across the nation, NASA’s Inspiration Tour convenes academic, industry, and public sector stakeholders to connect the agency with the people, technologies, and organizations that drive American leadership in space. 关键事实：NASA team members will engage with fans at the agency’s Experience Zone

entry.title: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy
entry.summary: Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory may have found a dramatically more efficient route to fusion energy by reversing the traditional approach: heating plasma first, then increasing its density. Their calculations could help future reactors reach self-sustaining fusion with far less energy while avoiding hidden problems that make ignition harder.
